lead: Every rocket launch on Earth: when the next one goes, what just flew, and which countries launch the most.
try: Look at the Coming up list for the next launch, then Just flew for what went up in the last few days.
points: These days a rocket goes up somewhere in the world about once a day or more.
The USA and China launch the most. India launches from Sriharikota, on its east coast.
Rockets usually fly east to borrow Earth's spin, which saves fuel.
